{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column from string to float, handling possible non-numeric values
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any NaN values after conversion
print("NaN values in revenue after conversion:", sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Display the first few rows to confirm
print(sales_df.head())"}
